The upstream NavigationEnv is a stable-baselines3 VecEnv (envs/NavigationEnv.py:27, envs/base/droneGymEnv.py:19); the driver's _NavigationGymAdapter translates its reset(state)/step four-tuple interface to the Gymnasium contract the bridge serves. The declared fidelity is F0 for the checked kinematic fake, not a claim about the upstream model. Expected family warnings: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only applies at the next reset) and four G8.NO_UNIT for the bridge-derived integer inputs; no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings. No extension capability ids are used, so catalogue_requests is empty.
